p.espaces.rg_d: Customs, product standards, start a business, investment platform: each country has its official sources.
p.espaces.rg_sub: Rules are often changed: ONE WORLD does not copy them, it opens up the up-to-date official source, and then you read them in your language.
p.espaces.rg_g1: Global Trade Helpdesk (ITC, UNCTAD, WTO): for a product and a country, duties, taxes, policies and procedures on one page
p.espaces.rg_g2: Market Access Map (ITC): customs duties and rules of origin
p.espaces.rg_g3: ePing (WTO): standards, labeling and health policies this country sets for products
p.espaces.rg_e1: Access2Markets: trade in and from the EU, step by step
p.espaces.rg_e2: TARIC: customs code and duties when entering the EU
p.espaces.rg_b1: Business Ready (World Bank): starting a business, taxation, international trade, country by country
p.espaces.rg_i1: I-SCAN (IOSCO): check that a platform is not flagged by a regulator before trusting it with money
p.espaces.rg_note: A site opens in its own language: use the translation of your browser, or « Understand a document » for a document. For an important decision, ask a professional in that country.
p.espaces.cu_d: Duties, documents, Incoterms, free official tools, forwarders and carriers.
p.espaces.cu_sub: A guide to buying and selling between countries. 24/24 ONE WORLD does not file customs declarations: a licensed customs broker (freight forwarder) can do it for you.
p.espaces.cu_t1: Market Access Map (ITC, UN-WTO): duties and rules for almost every country
p.espaces.cu_t2: Access2Markets (European Union): duties, taxes, rules of origin, step-by-step
p.espaces.cu_t3: TARIC: customs code (HS code) and duties when entering the European Union
p.espaces.cu_d3: Transportation documents: bill of lading (sea), air waybill (air), CMR (transit)
p.espaces.cu_d4: Certificate of origin (to get reduced duties)
p.espaces.cu_d5: EORI number (business import or export in the EU)
p.espaces.cu_d6: Depending on the product: health or phytosanitary certificate, license, CE standard
p.espaces.cu_i1: EXW: the buyer handles everything from the seller’s factory.
p.espaces.cu_i2: FCA: the seller delivers the goods already exported to the buyer’s forwarder.
p.espaces.cu_i3: FOB: the seller places the load on the ship; after that, the risks and costs are the buyer’s.
p.espaces.cu_i4: CIF: the seller pays the freight and insurance at the port of arrival.
p.espaces.cu_i5: DAP: the seller delivers at the destination, the buyer pays the customs duties on import.
p.espaces.cu_i6: DDP: the seller pays everything, including import duties.
p.espaces.cu_ban: Ban or controlled everywhere: weapons, drugs, counterfeits, protected species (CITES), some drugs. Such lists are rejected and may be reported (ar).
p.espaces.cu_src: Source: ICC (Incoterms 2020), ITC, European Commission, douane.gouv.fr. Always check the exact rules for your product.

p.espaces.mt_sub: 24/24 ONE WORLD does not send money itself and earns nothing from these links: you compare here, then you send the service of your choice.

p.espaces.mt_k2: Choose how the person will receive it: cash, bank account or mobile wallet (M-Pesa, Orange Money, MTN…).
p.espaces.mt_k3: An ID document is often required, both to send and to collect.
p.espaces.mt_k4: Never send money to someone you just met online, or to "unlock" a prize, a package, a loan or a visa: it's almost always a scam.
p.espaces.mt_note: Services and prices are changing: always check on their website when you ship.
p.espaces.ds_d: Sell without stock: find a supplier, work out the real price, stay within the law.
p.espaces.ds_sub: Dropshipping means selling a product that is shipped directly from the supplier to your customer. It's easy to get started, but you remain responsible for the sales.
p.espaces.ds_s1: Choose a product that is allowed in your customers’ country: no counterfeits, no regulated products without permission.
p.espaces.ds_s2: Find a supplier (Wholesale/supplier" listings here or wholesale platforms) and order samples before you sell.
p.espaces.ds_s3: Make the real price: product, shipping, customs duties, VAT of the customer’s country, payment fees and returns.
p.espaces.ds_s4: Tell your customers the actual delivery time.
p.espaces.ds_s5: Register your activity: business status, VAT and taxes according to your country (see trade rules).
p.espaces.ds_s6: Respect the rights of the customer: clear prices including taxes, right of return, warranty, data protection.
p.espaces.ds_w1: A supplier who wants full payment by unprotected bank transfer or in cryptocurrency.
p.espaces.ds_w2: Paid courses that promise to make you rich quickly.
p.espaces.ds_w3: Stolen photos and fake reviews: prohibited and punishable.
p.espaces.ds_w4: In the European Union, a parcel from outside the EU pays VAT from the first euro.
